title.narrative: Activity under preparation Global Gateway Investments in Circular Critical Raw Materials Value Chains

description.narrative: Circular economy is an alternative source ¿ next to mining ¿ to secure the supply of critical raw materials for a clean transition. For example, in 2050, the EU could potentially meet more than half to three quarters of its metal requirements for clean technologies through recycling. There is also a growing momentum for circular economy in partner countries, as exemplified by the number of recent circular economy policies, roadmaps, and action plans. For example, the African Union¿s Continental Circular Economy Action Plan for Africa identifies circularity as ¿a necessary strategic paradigm¿ for economically, environmentally, and socially sustainable development.In this context, the General Objective of this Action is to support the sustainable development of circular critical raw materials value chains.The Specific Objectives of this Action are:1. Connect CRM-rich waste streams in partner countries to sustainable EU CRM-recovery operations and technologies. 2. Support partners to sustainably scale recycling operations and to move up CRM recycling value chains. The Outputs to be delivered by this Action contributing to the corresponding Specific Objectives are:1.1 Strategic origination: CRM and metals-rich waste streams are systematically identified and developed with a view to supply feedstock from partner countries to the EU recycling industry.1.2 Enabling environment: Policies, capacities, and processes to sustainable manage waste in partner countries and to facilitate shipments of CRM and metals-rich waste to the EU are improved.2.1: Exploratory investments: direct technical and financial support to economic operators active in partner countries is provided to improve and to scale sustainable recycling operations. 2.2: Follow-on investment: CAPEX and OPEX support is provided for strategic early-stage and growth-stage circular CRM and metals projects in partner countries.This Action therefore covers the lifecycle of strategic CRM recycling projects ¿ from origination, over private sector development, to investments in strategic projects.
